description: Would you like to know how much you spend on your car? You want to control your expenses and see all the statistics of refills, services and other expenses? Then this app is for you. You only need to enter data about fueling, services or any other costs and application will calculate results and show statistics in various forms, in various categories and for different periods of time. And for added convenience, This free version of the app with advertising. If you like the app and want to support the developer or want to disable ads - buy Pro-version application.
